description.en:
Brings one character back into the party with the important return presentation. The jingle J_07 plays, the system message "sysmes-back_party" is shown with the character's name filled in (CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_CHARA), then the character is added with AddParty, and the function waits until the jingle has finished.
The current BGM is first stopped with a fade of 30 (CMND_SND_STOP); the function waits until it has stopped, then waits 30 more frames. Once everyone is added, the BGM starts again with the same fade.
It is a preset of AddParty_MessageEx(1, [_paramID], [_ptLock], [_avatarEnable], [_avatarLock], [_lv], 30, 30, "J_07", 0, "sysmes-back_party").
Parameter ID of the character to add, e.g. "para_cp0015".
Passed to CMND_SET_PT_LOCK_FLAG for the new member. Every shipped call passes true.
Passed to CMND_SET_AVATAR_ENABLE (whether the member's Fighting Spirit is enabled). Most shipped calls pass false; a few later events pass true for para_cp0009 and para_cp0010.
Passed to CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG for the new member.
Level to give the member with CMND_SET_LV. Only used when greater than 0.

examples.case: Typical call (not found in script_clean/; invented)
examples.code:
// para_cp0015 comes back at level 18
AddParty_Important_Message_Back("para_cp0015", true, false, false, 18);
